name: Aria Resort & Casino
insider_take: Where cutting-edge technology meets luxury gaming in the heart of the Strip – this is Vegas reimagined for the modern traveler.
whats_special: Aria is the world's largest LEED Gold-certified building, featuring an innovative air purification system that keeps the casino smoke-free in designated areas. The resort's CityCenter complex cost $8.5 billion to build, making it one of the most expensive privately-funded developments in U.S. history. Every guest room features floor-to-ceiling windows with automatic curtains that adjust based on time of day.
pro_tip: Download the Aria app to control your room's lighting, temperature, and TV from your phone – you can even unlock your door with it!
dont_miss: The stunning Crystals shopping center next door houses the world's largest Louis Vuitton store, and Aria's Sky Suites offer private gaming salons with dedicated entrances for the ultimate VIP experience. The resort's fine art collection includes works by Maya Lin and Frank Stella displayed throughout the property.
pros: Modern luxury accommodations with cutting-edge technology and sleek design
Prime Las Vegas Strip location with easy access to shopping and entertainment
Exceptional dining options including celebrity chef restaurants
World-class spa and wellness facilities with comprehensive treatments
cons: Large resort size may require walking distances to amenities
